text: Rohan Kulkarni is an embedded engineer at SmartCart Technologies, specializing in the development and optimization of hardware-software systems for e-commerce applications. His work focuses on creating reliable, efficient firmware solutions that integrate seamlessly with IoT-enabled devices. At SmartCart, he collaborates closely with cross-functional teams to design embedded systems that enhance product performance while maintaining scalability. A key aspect of his role involves leveraging Embedded Linux to build robust platforms that support real-time operations, ensuring stability in high-volume environments. He also plays a critical part in implementing IoT protocols like MQTT and CoAP, enabling secure and low-latency communication between devices and cloud services. With a strong foundation in RTOS development, Rohan contributes to projects requiring precise timing and resource management, such as sensor data processing and actuator control. His approach balances technical rigor with practical problem-solving, aiming to deliver solutions that align with the demands of modern e-commerce logistics. Beyond his current role, he is keen to deepen his expertise in embedded systems and explore innovations at the intersection of hardware and software in dynamic, scalable environments.
